project.name: Grandeur SEO Agent Harness v0.2
project.summary: Eleven agents plus the Agentic CMS's own agent run a client's search programme on a schedule: people approve ideas, agents draft, illustrate and publish, and reports prove it.

entities.name: Orchestrator (#0)
entities.summary: Reads the schedule, checks each run's preconditions, routes runs and passes the newest report file to the next agent.
entities.details: The only agent that starts work on its own clock. It never writes content; when an input is missing it logs the gap to the QA human ledger instead of guessing.
responsibilities: Pass the newest matching artifact to each consumer
Log missing inputs to the human ledger

entities.name: SEO action plan (#1)
entities.summary: Produces the plan every other agent works from: pillars, keyword strategy, traffic timeline and phase milestones.
entities.details: Runs rarely: once per brand, quarterly, or when the report agent fires a pivot flag. Uses the strongest model because it sets direction for everything downstream. A human approves the plan.

entities.name: Keyword research swarm (#2)
entities.summary: Every Monday refills the idea pipeline with 25-30 keywords, deduplicated against live and planned posts.
entities.details: Its output lands as Ideas in the CMS. Under v0.2 an idea is the only thing a human must approve before the agents take a post all the way to live.
responsibilities: Mine autocomplete, questions, communities and competitor gaps
Make honest difficulty calls with evidence
Prioritise pillars the KAS shows as claimed but unearned

entities.name: Blog writing agent (#3)
entities.summary: Writes the draft, the image production sheet and the [VERIFY] list for claims it could not source.
entities.details: Escalates to the strongest model for pillar and money pages. In v0.2 it no longer stops at a human image step: the production sheet is handed to the visual-asset agent.
responsibilities: Draft SEO/AEO posts from an approved idea

entities.name: On-page SEO optimizer (#4)
entities.summary: Scores every draft against the on-page checklist and produces the optimized post.
entities.details: Its scorecard is the input to the CMS agent's auto-gate. Failing items in the first five sections are hard blocks.
responsibilities: Audit title, headings, keyword placement, links, FAQ and schema

entities.name: Technical SEO monitor (#5)
entities.summary: Friday health digest: indexability, broken links, sitemap and robots, HTTPS, Core Web Vitals signals, schema.
entities.details: Mostly mechanical, so it runs on the fast model and escalates ambiguous diagnoses.

entities.name: Content refresh agent (#6)
entities.summary: Finds decaying and page-2 posts, drafts refreshed versions, and proposes a prune list.
entities.details: Refresh drafts re-enter the CMS pipeline. Pruning a page always needs a human sign-off.

entities.name: Link-building prospector (#7)
entities.summary: Builds the link prospect pipeline and outreach drafts.
entities.details: Outreach is identity work: a human personalises and sends every email.

entities.name: SEO QA agent (#8)
entities.summary: Checks other agents' output against their contracts and against the live site, and demands human updates with deadlines.
entities.details: Weekly light run, bi-weekly full run. Owns the human ledger: items go overdue at 7 days and become named blockers at 14.

entities.name: Visualization report agent (#9)
entities.summary: Produces the bi-weekly visual progress report and raises pivot flags.
entities.details: Escalates to the strongest model when a pivot trigger fires; a pivot flag queues an action-plan review via the orchestrator.
responsibilities: Build the report from the bound template

entities.name: Visual asset agent (#10) - new in v0.2
entities.summary: Fills every image slot: generates brand imagery through connected MCP servers or image APIs, builds SVG diagrams from the post's own facts, or sources licensed images from the web.
entities.details: Chooses a route per slot type. Records provider, model, prompt, license, creator and source URL for every asset. If a provider fails it tries the next route; if none works it holds the slot and adds a ledger item. Charts are always inline SVG, never generated.
responsibilities: Route each slot: generate, diagram, or source
Inject brand palette and style keywords into every prompt
Post-process to WebP/AVIF at template breakpoints

evidence.excerpt: routing: brand_imagery / diagram / text_in_image / volume / chart / stock_or_real_world
export function chooseRoute(slot, connections, brandPack, override)

limitations: Only web sourcing (Openverse) and template SVG diagrams were exercised with real calls; MCP, image-API and Claude-diagram paths are unit-tested but untried without keys.
Post-processing (WebP/AVIF, resizing) and the on-disk provenance log are not built yet.

entities.name: CMS agent (product surface)
entities.role: Post state owner and sole repo writer
entities.summary: The Agentic CMS's native agent: owns post state, renders posts into the site's template, runs the auto-gate under autopost, and is the only component that opens and merges merge requests.
entities.details: Not part of the harness count of 11. It calls the harness agents and consumes their artifacts. With autopost on it sources or rewrites open claims, accepts soft blocks with a logged reason, opens the MR and merges it when the repo's CI passes; any hard block it cannot clear holds the post for a human.
responsibilities: Render posts into the site's own markup
Run the auto-gate and open/merge MRs
Recalculate keyword attribution after each merge
limitations: In the current Agentic CMS build the agent's work is simulated in the client store; the model is configurable in the CMS.

entities.name: Claude Opus 5.5
entities.summary: Strategy runs, pillar and money pages, pivot analysis.
entities.details: Tier logic from HARNESS.md: the fast model for mechanical high-frequency work, the workhorse for writing and judgment, the strongest reserved for rare strategy-setting runs. IDs must be verified against the provider docs before wiring API calls.
entities.selectionRule: Declared per agent in harness-config.yaml (strongest tier); escalation rules move specific runs up a tier
entities.fallback: unknown - no fallback model is declared

entities.name: Claude Sonnet 5
entities.summary: Writing, judgment, QA, reporting and image routing.
entities.details: Tier logic from HARNESS.md: the fast model for mechanical high-frequency work, the workhorse for writing and judgment, the strongest reserved for rare strategy-setting runs. IDs must be verified against the provider docs before wiring API calls.
entities.selectionRule: Declared per agent in harness-config.yaml (workhorse tier); escalation rules move specific runs up a tier
entities.fallback: unknown - no fallback model is declared

entities.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
entities.summary: High-frequency routing and mechanical crawling.
entities.details: Tier logic from HARNESS.md: the fast model for mechanical high-frequency work, the workhorse for writing and judgment, the strongest reserved for rare strategy-setting runs. IDs must be verified against the provider docs before wiring API calls.
entities.selectionRule: Declared per agent in harness-config.yaml (fast tier); escalation rules move specific runs up a tier
entities.fallback: unknown - no fallback model is declared

entities.name: Shared reports folder
entities.summary: Every agent reads and writes dated artifacts here; the orchestrator hands the newest matching file to each consumer.
entities.retention: Dated files are kept, so delta reporting works across runs
entities.correctionPath: Rerun the producing agent; the newer dated file supersedes the old one

entities.name: Human ledger
entities.summary: Human-owned items with deadlines, written by the QA agent and shown in every report and in the CMS.
entities.retention: Items age until resolved: overdue at 7 days, named blocker at 14
entities.correctionPath: The owner resolves the item in the CMS; QA verifies on its next run

entities.name: Asset provenance log
entities.summary: For every asset: provider, model, prompt, license, creator, source URL and date, needed for client disclosure and licensing questions.
entities.retention: unknown - travels with the asset into the repo commit
entities.correctionPath: Regenerate or replace the asset; a new provenance record is written

entities.name: Agentic CMS post store
entities.summary: Posts, versions, gate results, merge requests, runs, ledger and audit events for each site.
entities.retention: Prototype: browser localStorage under cms.state.v1; the PRD specifies Postgres for production
entities.correctionPath: Restore a version, or 'Reset demo data' in the prototype

entities.name: Image MCP servers
entities.summary: Higgsfield (preferred) or any custom MCP server the site connects; used for brand-styled hero and lifestyle imagery with consistent characters and elements.

evidence.excerpt: export async function callMcpTool(id, toolName, args)

entities.name: Image APIs
entities.summary: OpenAI image models for legible text-in-image; open-source models (Replicate, fal) for cheap volume batches.

entities.name: Licensed web image sources
entities.summary: Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, or the site's own stock API; license, creator and attribution are recorded.

entities.name: Git host (GitHub or GitLab app)
entities.summary: Path-scoped app installation; the CMS agent opens one branch and MR per post and merges on green CI under autopost.

entities.name: Google Search Console
entities.summary: Required data source for refresh targeting, KAS and the report; lags roughly 2-3 days.

entities.name: Keyword Attribution Score
entities.summary: Ordinary code that turns impressions x click-through curve x intent value into each keyword's share of the site's search weight.
entities.details: Not an LLM. Recalculated 24 h after each merge, then weekly; the swarm, refresh and report agents all read it.

entities.name: Template renderer
entities.role: Posts into the site's own markup
entities.summary: Parses an uploaded .html/.zip template, then maps each post into the template's real elements, classes and image containers for the live preview and the MR; never invents markup (missing structures are held).

evidence.excerpt: Fidelity rule. The renderer never invents markup.

entities.name: Human gates
entities.summary: Approve ideas, approve the plan, send outreach, delete or prune pages, and spend above the cap.
entities.details: v0.2 replaced the v0.1 'publish' gate with 'approve_idea'. Publishing is automated, not bypassed.

entities.name: Autopost auto-gate
entities.summary: On by default per site. Open claims are sourced or rewritten first; hard blocks the agents cannot clear hold the post for a person. With autopost off, every post stops at human review.

evidence.excerpt: Publishing is automatic by default ... never ships around a block.

entities.name: No fabricated claims
entities.summary: Unsourced statistics, quotes or citations never ship; they are sourced or removed before publishing.

entities.name: Spend caps
entities.summary: Every run is estimated first; runs above the site's monthly cap are refused, with an alert at 80%.

entities.name: Image guardrails
entities.summary: No identifiable real people unless licensed, no living-artist style imitation, no watermarks, no non-commercial licenses on commercial sites, diagrams only from the post's facts, provenance for every asset.

entities.name: Repo scope
entities.summary: The integration writes only to the declared content and asset paths and never pushes to the base branch; the repo's own CI decides merges.

evidence.excerpt: Repo access. Path-scoped to the declared content and asset directories.

entities.name: Agentic CMS
entities.summary: Where people approve ideas, watch posts ship, connect image providers, upload templates and read the SEO trajectory.

entities.name: Bi-weekly report
entities.summary: Visual HTML report with health score, KPI deltas, charts, the human ledger and pivot calls.

entities.name: Connection store
entities.summary: Per-site MCP servers, image APIs and web sources; secrets are held server-side, never returned by any route and never put in prompts.
entities.correctionPath: Edit or remove the connection in Settings - Connections; changing a key resets its status to untested

features.name: Approved idea ships on its own
features.summary: After a person approves an idea, the agents draft, illustrate, check and publish it through a merge request that merges on green CI.

features.name: Every image slot filled
features.summary: Generated, diagrammed or licensed-sourced images with provenance, so posts never wait on a designer.

features.name: Human review when autopost is off
features.summary: Sites that turn autopost off get the original In review gate for every post.

features.name: Keyword Attribution Score
features.summary: Shows which keywords and pages carry the site's search weight and proves what a post changed.

features.name: Bi-weekly progress and pivots
features.summary: A visual report every second Friday with pivot flags that can re-open strategy.

features.name: Human work is tracked, not forgotten
features.summary: The ledger ages human items to overdue at 7 days and blocker at 14, visible to the client.

features.name: Site health, refreshes and links
features.summary: Weekly technical digest, monthly refresh drafts and prune list, monthly link prospects with human-sent outreach.
